en: to take in a liquid, or to deal with a cost
toeic: The company will absorb the extra shipping costs.
toeic_zh: 公司將承擔額外的運費。

en: a person who keeps or checks financial records
toeic: The accountant prepared the quarterly tax report.
toeic_zh: 會計師準備了季度報稅表。

en: to gradually collect a larger amount
simple: Dust will accumulate on the shelf.
toeic: Frequent flyers can accumulate points with every trip.
toeic_zh: 常客可以在每次旅程中累積點數。

en: in a correct and exact way
toeic: The report must accurately reflect the company's earnings.
toeic_zh: 報告必須準確反映公司的收益。

en: once every year
simple_zh: 我們每年支付這張帳單。
toeic: The board meets annually to review the company's financial plans.
toeic_zh: 董事會每年開會一次，檢討公司的財務計畫。
family: annual (adj) 每年的; annual report 年報; monthly (adv); quarterly (adv)

en: a lawyer who represents clients
toeic: Our attorney will review the agreement before we sign it.
toeic_zh: 我們的律師會在簽約前審閱這份協議。

en: a person who checks financial records
simple_zh: 審計員檢查了我們的紀錄。
toeic: An external auditor will inspect the annual accounts.
toeic_zh: 外部審計員將查核年度帳目。

en: a person who works in or owns a bank
toeic: The banker explained the terms of the business loan.
toeic_zh: 銀行員說明了企業貸款的條款。

en: not able to pay what you owe
simple: The shop went bankrupt last year.
toeic: The retailer went bankrupt after losing its largest customer.
toeic_zh: 這家零售商在失去最大客戶後破產了。
family: bankruptcy (n) 破產; go bankrupt 破產; declare bankruptcy 宣告破產

en: the state of being unable to pay debts
toeic: The company filed for bankruptcy after losing its biggest client.
toeic_zh: 公司在失去最大客戶後申請破產。

en: Certain to happen, or required by a rule.
toeic: Both parties are bound by the terms of the contract.
toeic_zh: 雙方皆受合約條款約束。

en: A rule made by a company or local authority.
simple: The by-law says no parking here.
simple_zh: 規章規定這裡不可停車。
toeic: The by-law requires a majority vote to change the budget.
toeic_zh: 該規章規定變更預算須經多數決。

en: The act of finding an amount using numbers.
toeic: The accountant checked each calculation before sending the report.
toeic_zh: 會計師在送出報告前檢查了每一項計算。

en: A small machine that does math for you.
toeic: Use the calculator to confirm the total on the invoice.
toeic_zh: 請用計算機確認發票上的總額。

en: Careful to avoid risk or danger.
simple: Be cautious on the icy road.
toeic: Investors remain cautious about the new market.
toeic_zh: 投資人對這個新市場仍持謹慎態度。

en: Giving help or money to people in need.
toeic: The firm made a charitable donation to the local school.
toeic_zh: 該公司向當地學校捐出一筆慈善捐款。

en: A person who gathers things, such as art or payments.
simple: My father is a stamp collector.
toeic: The tax collector will visit the office on Monday.
toeic_zh: 稅務員週一會到辦公室拜訪。

en: a decrease in size or amount
toeic: The report predicts a contraction in the housing market this year.
toeic_zh: 報告預測今年房市將出現萎縮。

en: growing by adding more over time
toeic: The cumulative sales for the year reached two million dollars.
toeic_zh: 全年累計銷售額達到兩百萬美元。

en: money taken out of a bank account
simple: I paid with a debit card.
toeic: A debit of fifty dollars was made to your account yesterday.
toeic_zh: 昨天您的帳戶被扣款五十美元。

en: to take an amount away from a total
simple: They deduct money from my pay.
simple_zh: 他們從我的薪水裡扣錢。
toeic: The company will deduct the insurance fee from your monthly salary.
toeic_zh: 公司會從你的月薪中扣除保險費。
family: deduction (n) 扣除額; deductible (adj) 可扣除的; tax deduction 稅額減免

en: portion of company profits paid to shareholders
toeic: Dividend yields are attractive.
toeic_zh: 股息收益率很高。

en: to give money or things to help others
toeic: The firm will donate ten percent of its profits to local schools.
toeic_zh: 該公司將把百分之十的利潤捐給當地學校。

en: money or goods given to help
toeic: All donations will go to the new children's hospital.
toeic_zh: 所有捐款都將用於新的兒童醫院。

en: a period when business or the economy gets worse
simple: The economy has a downturn this year.
toeic: The company cut costs during the economic downturn.
toeic_zh: 公司在經濟衰退期間削減了成本。

en: saving money, time, or resources
simple: This car is economical to drive.
toeic: The new printer is a more economical choice for our office.
toeic_zh: 新印表機是我們辦公室更經濟實惠的選擇。

en: in a way related to money or saving money
toeic: The project is economically sound and should bring profit.
toeic_zh: 這項專案在經濟上可行，應該會帶來獲利。

en: to spend less money or use less of something
simple_zh: 我們必須節省食物開支。
toeic: The firm decided to economize by reducing travel expenses.
toeic_zh: 公司決定藉由減少差旅費用來節省開支。

en: a person who starts a new business
toeic: The entrepreneur launched her start-up with a small loan.
toeic_zh: 這位企業家靠一筆小額貸款創辦了新創公司。

en: the money used in many European countries
simple: One euro is not much money.
toeic: The invoice must be paid in euros.
toeic_zh: 發票必須以歐元支付。

en: more than is needed or reasonable
toeic: Excessive spending forced the department to cut its budget.
toeic_zh: 過度支出迫使該部門削減預算。

en: permission to not follow a rule or pay a fee
simple: He got an exemption from the fee.
toeic: Nonprofit groups may apply for a tax exemption.
toeic_zh: 非營利團體可以申請免稅。

en: related to money, taxes and a company's accounts
simple: Our fiscal year starts in April.
simple_zh: 我們的會計年度從四月開始。
toeic: The fiscal year ends on March 31 for most Japanese companies.
toeic_zh: 大多數日本公司的會計年度在三月三十一日結束。
family: fiscal year 會計年度; fiscal policy 財政政策; fiscally (adv)

en: to change often, going up and down
toeic: Oil prices fluctuate depending on the global market.
toeic_zh: 油價會隨全球市場而波動。

en: the activity of collecting money for a cause
toeic: The charity organized a fundraising dinner to support the new school.
toeic_zh: 該慈善機構舉辦募款晚宴來支持新學校。

en: a sign or number that shows a condition
toeic: Rising sales are a key indicator of the company's success.
toeic_zh: 銷售成長是公司成功的關鍵指標。

en: to fill with air, or to raise prices
toeic: Some stores inflate prices just before the holiday season.
toeic_zh: 有些商店在假期旺季前哄抬價格。

en: having a strong effect on people or decisions
simple_zh: 她是個有影響力的領導者。
toeic: The influential investor supported the merger plan.
toeic_zh: 這位有影響力的投資人支持合併計畫。

en: not regular or not following a pattern
toeic: The audit found several irregular transactions in the account.
toeic_zh: 稽核發現該帳戶有幾筆不尋常的交易。

en: To join two things or companies into one
simple: The two banks will merge next year.
simple_zh: 這兩家銀行明年將合併。
toeic: The two firms plan to merge to cut costs.
toeic_zh: 這兩家公司打算合併以降低成本。

en: combination of two companies into one entity
toeic: Merger accounting follows GAAP rules.
toeic_zh: 合併會計遵循GAAP規則。

en: The distance traveled in miles
toeic: Employees can claim mileage for business trips.
toeic_zh: 員工出差可申請里程補貼。

en: Poor and lacking basic things
simple_zh: 這個慈善機構幫助貧困家庭。
toeic: The company donates food to needy people each winter.
toeic_zh: 公司每年冬天都捐贈食物給貧困的人。

en: To make someone have to do something
simple: The contract will obligate us to pay.
simple_zh: 合約會使我們有義務付款。
toeic: The agreement may obligate both sides to share the costs.
toeic_zh: 該協議可能使雙方都有義務分擔費用。

en: To force someone or to help someone as a favor
simple: The rule will oblige us to wear helmets.
simple_zh: 這條規定要求我們戴安全帽。
toeic: The law may oblige companies to report their earnings.
toeic_zh: 法律可能要求公司申報收益。

en: Expecting good things to happen
simple: She is optimistic about the test.
toeic: We are optimistic about next quarter's sales.
toeic_zh: 我們對下一季的銷售感到樂觀。

en: able to be paid; amount owed by a company
toeic: Payable terms affect cash flow.
toeic_zh: 應付條款影響現金流。

en: a statement about what will happen
toeic: The prediction shows that sales will rise next quarter.
toeic_zh: 預測顯示下一季銷售將上升。

en: significant economic slowdown or contraction
toeic: Recession impacts unemployment rates.
toeic_zh: 衰退影響失業率。

en: suddenly and by a large amount
toeic: Sales dropped sharply after the competitor lowered its prices.
toeic_zh: 競爭對手降價後，銷售額急劇下滑。

en: to rise quickly to a high level
toeic: Sales are expected to soar after the product launch.
toeic_zh: 產品上市後，銷售額預計將急遽攀升。

en: numbers that show facts about something
toeic: Recent statistics show that online sales have doubled.
toeic_zh: 最近的統計數據顯示線上銷售已經翻倍。

en: in a regular and continuous way
toeic: Our profits have increased steadily over the past five years.
toeic_zh: 我們的利潤在過去五年穩定成長。

en: something that makes activity or growth increase
simple: Good news is a stimulus for sales.
toeic: The government introduced a stimulus package to boost the economy.
toeic_zh: 政府推出刺激方案來提振經濟。

en: a person who buys and sells shares for others
toeic: Contact your stockbroker before selling any shares.
toeic_zh: 出售任何股票前請先聯絡您的股票經紀人。

en: person or entity that owns shares in a company
toeic: Stockholder meetings occur annually.
toeic_zh: 股東大會每年舉行。

en: to pay part of the cost of something
simple: The city will subsidize the bus.
toeic: The government will subsidize the cost of solar panels.
toeic_zh: 政府將補貼太陽能板的費用。

en: by a large amount
toeic: Revenue has increased substantially since last quarter.
toeic_zh: 營收自上一季以來大幅增加。

en: to take one number away from another
toeic: Subtract the discount from the total to find the final price.
toeic_zh: 從總額中減去折扣，即可得出最終價格。

en: making you feel something is wrong
simple_zh: 那個男人看起來很可疑。
toeic: Report any suspicious activity on your account immediately.
toeic_zh: 請立即回報您帳戶上任何可疑的活動。

en: When one company buys control of another company.
simple: The takeover was in the news.
toeic: The board approved the takeover after reviewing the final offer.
toeic_zh: 董事會在審閱最終出價後核准了這項收購。

en: Not needed.
toeic: We should cut unnecessary expenses to improve profit.
toeic_zh: 我們應削減不必要的開支以提高利潤。

en: In a smart way.
toeic: The manager wisely chose to delay the product launch.
toeic_zh: 經理明智地決定延後產品上市。

en: removal of money from a bank account
simple: Make a withdrawal at the ATM.
toeic: Withdrawal fees apply after 3 transactions.
toeic_zh: 3次交易後收取提取費用。

en: The money used in Japan.
toeic: The price was converted from yen to dollars at today's rate.
toeic_zh: 價格已依今日匯率從日圓換算成美元。

en: income or expense recorded when earned or incurred
toeic: Accruals must be adjusted periodically.
toeic_zh: 應計項目必須定期調整。

en: spreading payment of a loan or cost over time
toeic: Amortization schedules show payments.
toeic_zh: 攤銷計劃顯示付款。

en: financial product providing regular income payments
simple_zh: 年金提供有保證的收入。
toeic: Annuity rates are attractive.
toeic_zh: 年金利率很有吸引力。

en: buying and selling same asset in different markets for profit
toeic: Arbitrage opportunities are rare today.
toeic_zh: 套利機會今天很少見。

en: A person or company that takes a loan.
simple: The borrower must pay every month.
simple_zh: 借款人每個月都必須還款。
toeic: Each borrower must submit tax records along with the loan form.
toeic_zh: 每位借款人都必須連同貸款表格一併提交稅務紀錄。

en: assets pledged as security for a loan
toeic: Collateral value determines loan amount.
toeic_zh: 擔保品價值決定貸款額度。

en: combining of financial statements of related entities
toeic: Consolidation is required for groups.
toeic_zh: 集團需要合併。

en: binding agreement or promise in a contract
toeic: Loan covenants require quarterly reports.
toeic_zh: 貸款契約條款需要季度報告。

en: A person or company that is owed money.
simple: The creditor wants his money back.
simple_zh: 債權人想要拿回他的錢。
toeic: The company agreed to pay each creditor within sixty days.
toeic_zh: 公司同意在六十天內付款給每位債權人。

en: A person or company that owes money.
simple: The debtor has no money today.
toeic: Late debtor payments have hurt our cash position this quarter.
toeic_zh: 債務人延遲付款傷害了我們本季的現金狀況。

en: failure to meet financial obligation
toeic: Default penalties are severe.
toeic_zh: 違約罰款很嚴厲。

en: general decrease in prices and increase in currency value
toeic: Deflation poses policy challenges.
toeic_zh: 通縮帶來政策挑戰。

en: spreading investments across different assets to reduce risk
toeic: Diversification strategy involves sectors.
toeic_zh: 多元化戰略涉及部門。

en: ownership stake in a company; assets minus liabilities
simple: Shareholders own equity in the company.
toeic: Equity value increased this quarter.
toeic_zh: 本季度股權價值增加。

en: person legally required to act in another's best interest
toeic: Fiduciary duty is legally binding.
toeic_zh: 受信人責任具有法律約束力。

en: intentional deception for unlawful gain
toeic: Fraud detection requires vigilance.
toeic_zh: 詐欺檢測需要警惕。

en: intangible asset from acquiring a company at premium price
simple_zh: 商譽出現在資產負債表上。
toeic: Goodwill impairment requires testing.
toeic_zh: 商譽減損需要測試。

en: To protect money from loss by making a second deal.
simple: Banks hedge to avoid losing money.
toeic: Exporters often hedge against currency changes with forward contracts.
toeic_zh: 出口商通常以遠期合約來對沖匯率變動。

en: significant decline in asset value below book value
toeic: Impairment testing is required annually.
toeic_zh: 減損測試每年進行。

en: book or record of financial transactions by account
toeic: General ledger records are permanent.
toeic_zh: 總帳記錄是永久的。

en: A person or bank that lends money.
simple: The lender gave us a small loan.
simple_zh: 貸款人借給我們一小筆錢。
toeic: The lender requires proof of income before approving the application.
toeic_zh: 放款機構在核准申請前要求提供收入證明。

en: An official charge or tax collected by the government.
simple: The city added a new levy this year.
simple_zh: 市政府今年新增了一項稅款。
toeic: The government introduced a levy on large bank transactions.
toeic_zh: 政府對大額銀行交易徵收一項稅款。

en: ability to quickly convert assets to cash
simple_zh: 流動性對於運營至關重要。
toeic: Liquidity ratios assess cash availability.
toeic_zh: 流動性比率評估現金可用性。

en: Producing a lot of money.
simple: He found a lucrative job in banking.
simple_zh: 他在銀行業找到一份高薪的工作。
toeic: The company signed a lucrative contract with an overseas retailer.
toeic_zh: 公司與一家海外零售商簽下獲利豐厚的合約。

en: date when a debt obligation becomes due for payment
toeic: Maturity dates require payment planning.
toeic_zh: 到期日期需要支付規劃。

en: An amount of money spent on something.
simple: The first outlay was very small.
toeic: The new factory requires a large initial outlay of capital.
toeic_zh: 新工廠需要龐大的初期資金支出。

en: able to be received; amount owed to a company
simple_zh: 應收款出現在資產負債表上。
toeic: Receivable aging affects collections.
toeic_zh: 應收款賬齡影響催收。

en: Money paid to an owner for using their work or idea.
simple: The singer gets a royalty for each song.
simple_zh: 這位歌手每賣一首歌就能拿到版稅。
toeic: The firm pays a royalty to the inventor for every unit sold.
toeic_zh: 該公司每賣出一件產品就付權利金給發明者。

en: buying/selling to profit from price changes
toeic: Speculation increases market volatility.
toeic_zh: 投機增加市場波動性。

en: Money given by the government to help a business.
simple: The farm gets a subsidy every year.
simple_zh: 這座農場每年都拿到補助金。
toeic: The government offers a subsidy to firms that install solar panels.
toeic_zh: 政府對安裝太陽能板的公司提供補助金。

en: person holding and managing property for another's benefit
toeic: Trustee responsibilities are significant.
toeic_zh: 受託人責任很大。

en: process of determining the worth or value of an asset
toeic: Valuation methods vary by industry.
toeic_zh: 估值方法因行業而異。

en: Changing quickly and often, especially in price.
simple: Oil prices are volatile this week.
toeic: Investors are cautious because the market remains highly volatile.
toeic_zh: 由於市場仍然劇烈波動，投資人保持謹慎。

en: degree of price fluctuation in a security or market
toeic: Volatility index measures market fear.
toeic_zh: 波動性指數衡量市場恐懼。

en: Very serious and worrying.
toeic: The report warned of grave financial risks for the company.
toeic_zh: 報告警告該公司面臨嚴重的財務風險。

en: a thin pointed metal piece for holding things
simple: I put a pin in the map.
simple_zh: 我在地圖上插了一根大頭針。
toeic: Please enter your PIN to access the account.
toeic_zh: 請輸入您的密碼以存取帳戶。

en: the government department that manages money
toeic: Investors bought Treasury bonds to reduce their risk.
toeic_zh: 投資人購買公債以降低風險。

en: a shocking event that harms a reputation
simple_zh: 這個醜聞震驚了所有人。
toeic: The accounting scandal damaged the firm's reputation.
toeic_zh: 會計醜聞損害了這家公司的聲譽。

en: relating to numbers and data analysis
toeic: The statistical report shows a steady rise in sales.
toeic_zh: 統計報告顯示銷售額穩定上升。

en: a person or device that manages something
toeic: The financial controller approved the annual budget.
toeic_zh: 財務主管核准了年度預算。

en: smaller or less important
toeic: The firm faces lesser risks in the domestic market.
toeic_zh: 公司在國內市場面臨的風險較小。

en: a triangle-shaped river mouth; a small change
simple: The river makes a delta near the sea.
simple_zh: 這條河在海邊形成三角洲。
toeic: The delta between forecast and actual sales was small.
toeic_zh: 預測與實際銷售額之間的差距很小。

en: a separate organization or thing with its own existence
simple: The company is a legal entity.
simple_zh: 這家公司是一個法人實體。
toeic: Each subsidiary is treated as a separate legal entity for tax purposes.
toeic_zh: 就稅務而言，每家子公司都被視為獨立的法人實體。

en: in a straight line or step-by-step order
simple: Draw a linear line on the paper.
toeic: Sales showed a linear increase over the past six months.
toeic_zh: 過去六個月的銷售額呈線性成長。

en: related to money
simple: The gift has little monetary value.
simple_zh: 這個禮物的金錢價值不高。
toeic: The central bank changed its monetary policy to control inflation.
toeic_zh: 中央銀行改變貨幣政策以控制通貨膨脹。

en: the way an organization is controlled and managed
simple: Good governance helps a city grow.
simple_zh: 良好的治理有助於城市成長。
toeic: The board is reviewing its corporate governance rules.
toeic_zh: 董事會正在檢討公司治理規範。

en: a legal case brought to a court
toeic: The company faces a lawsuit over a defective product.
toeic_zh: 該公司因瑕疵產品而面臨訴訟。

en: in relation to past times
simple: Historically, this town was very small.
simple_zh: 在歷史上，這個小鎮很小。
toeic: Sales have historically been strongest in the fourth quarter.
toeic_zh: 銷售額在歷史上一向以第四季最高。

en: unfriendly and ready to oppose
simple: The man gave me a hostile look.
simple_zh: 那個男人對我投以敵意的眼神。
toeic: The board rejected the hostile takeover offer.
toeic_zh: 董事會拒絕了惡意收購的提議。

en: small and not important
simple: Do not argue about petty things.
toeic: Petty cash is used for small office expenses.
toeic_zh: 零用金用於辦公室的小額開銷。

en: in a way related to politics
simple_zh: 這個國家在政治上很穩定。
toeic: The region is politically unstable, so investors are cautious.
toeic_zh: 該地區政局不穩，因此投資人保持謹慎。

en: a small drop in level or amount
simple: There was a dip in sales.
toeic: The company saw a slight dip in profits last quarter.
toeic_zh: 公司上一季的利潤略微下滑。

en: the middle value in a set of numbers
simple: The median age here is thirty.
simple_zh: 這裡的年齡中位數是三十歲。
toeic: The median income in the city rose last year.
toeic_zh: 這座城市的收入中位數去年上升了。

en: not moving or changing
simple: The price stayed static all year.
toeic: Sales figures have remained static for three months.
toeic_zh: 銷售數字已連續三個月沒有變動。

en: to break; (informal) to fail financially
toeic: Many small shops went bust during the economic crisis.
toeic_zh: 許多小店在經濟危機期間倒閉。

en: related to mathematics
toeic: The analyst built a mathematical model to predict demand.
toeic_zh: 分析師建立了一個數學模型來預測需求。

en: small or moderate in size; not proud
simple: She is modest about her success.
simple_zh: 她對自己的成功很謙虛。
toeic: The company reported a modest increase in profits.
toeic_zh: 該公司公布利潤小幅成長。

en: a line that something turns around; a chart line
simple: The Earth turns on its axis.
toeic: The horizontal axis of the chart shows the months.
toeic_zh: 圖表的橫軸顯示月份。

en: to jump back after hitting something
simple: The ball will bounce on the floor.
toeic: The check will bounce if there is not enough money in the account.
toeic_zh: 如果帳戶餘額不足，這張支票會被退票。

en: money paid to free someone from jail until trial
simple: He paid bail and went home.
simple_zh: 他繳了保釋金後回家了。
toeic: The government decided to bail out the struggling bank.
toeic_zh: 政府決定紓困這家陷入困境的銀行。

en: the act of making secret information known
simple_zh: 這項揭露讓每個人都很驚訝。
toeic: The law requires full disclosure of all fees to customers.
toeic_zh: 法律要求向顧客完整揭露所有費用。

en: with the subtraction of
toeic: The net profit, minus taxes, was lower than expected.
toeic_zh: 扣除稅金後的淨利低於預期。

en: a company or group connected to a larger one
simple: This shop is an affiliate of a big brand.
simple_zh: 這家店是大品牌的關係企業。
toeic: Our overseas affiliate will handle all customer orders in Asia.
toeic_zh: 我們的海外關係企業將負責亞洲所有客戶訂單。

en: to look into something carefully to find the truth
simple: The police will probe the case.
toeic: Regulators will probe the company's accounting practices.
toeic_zh: 監管機關將調查該公司的會計作業。

en: in a way that relates to money
simple_zh: 他們現在財務上很安穩。
toeic: The firm is financially stable despite the market downturn.
toeic_zh: 儘管市場低迷，該公司財務上仍很穩健。

en: an economic system where private owners run businesses for profit
simple_zh: 許多國家實行資本主義。
toeic: Critics argue that capitalism increases the gap between rich and poor.
toeic_zh: 批評者認為資本主義擴大了貧富差距。

en: a feeling that something is wrong
simple: I have a suspicion about him.
toeic: The auditor reported her suspicion of fraud to management.
toeic_zh: 稽核員向管理階層報告了她對詐欺的懷疑。

en: a very small part of something
simple: I only ate a fraction of the cake.
simple_zh: 我只吃了蛋糕的一小部分。
toeic: The new system costs only a fraction of the old one.
toeic_zh: 新系統的成本只有舊系統的一小部分。

en: in the middle of something
simple: She stayed calm amid the noise.
toeic: Sales rose amid growing competition in the market.
toeic_zh: 在市場競爭加劇之際，銷售額仍有成長。

en: the total amount made from adding smaller parts
simple: The aggregate of sales was high.
toeic: The aggregate demand for solar panels grew sharply this year.
toeic_zh: 今年太陽能板的總需求量大幅成長。

en: likely to cause loss or harm
toeic: Investing in a single stock is a risky strategy.
toeic_zh: 只投資單一股票是有風險的策略。

en: to press hard on something; to reduce
simple: Squeeze the lemon into the water.
toeic: Rising costs continue to squeeze profit margins.
toeic_zh: 成本上升持續壓縮利潤空間。

en: the process of taking a legal case to court
toeic: The firm is spending heavily on litigation over patent rights.
toeic_zh: 該公司在專利權訴訟上花費龐大。

en: the act of becoming active or popular again
simple: The town needs an economic revival.
simple_zh: 這個城鎮需要經濟復甦。
toeic: Analysts expect a revival in consumer spending next year.
toeic_zh: 分析師預期明年消費支出將回升。

en: a person or group that gives money or help
simple_zh: 捐贈者給了我們一些錢。
toeic: A generous donor funded the new hospital wing.
toeic_zh: 一位慷慨的捐贈者出資興建醫院新側翼。

en: a company owned by a larger company
simple: This firm is a subsidiary of ours.
simple_zh: 這家公司是我們的子公司。
toeic: The Tokyo office operates as a wholly owned subsidiary.
toeic_zh: 東京辦公室是一家完全持股的子公司。

en: located or done at sea or in another country
simple: He works on an offshore oil rig.
simple_zh: 他在離岸石油鑽油平台工作。
toeic: The company moved its call center to an offshore location.
toeic_zh: 該公司把客服中心遷到海外。

en: a state of success and having plenty of money
simple: We wish you health and prosperity.
toeic: Trade brought prosperity to the whole region.
toeic_zh: 貿易為整個地區帶來繁榮。

en: in a way that cannot be avoided
toeic: Costs will inevitably rise as raw materials become scarce.
toeic_zh: 隨著原料變得稀少，成本勢必上升。

en: A link between two things
toeic: The report shows a strong correlation between price and sales.
toeic_zh: 報告顯示價格與銷售之間有高度相關性。

en: A person who pays taxes
simple: Every taxpayer must file a form.
simple_zh: 每位納稅人都必須提交表格。
toeic: The new road was paid for by local taxpayers.
toeic_zh: 新道路由當地納稅人出資興建。

en: The act of controlling something in a clever or unfair way
simple: The data showed signs of manipulation.
simple_zh: 資料顯示有被操縱的跡象。
toeic: The firm was fined for the manipulation of stock prices.
toeic_zh: 該公司因操縱股價而被罰款。

en: A difference between amounts or rates
toeic: The pay differential between the two positions is quite large.
toeic_zh: 這兩個職位的薪資差距相當大。

en: Existing as a natural part of something
simple_zh: 風險是商業固有的一部分。
toeic: There are inherent risks in any overseas investment.
toeic_zh: 任何海外投資都有其固有風險。

en: A person who examines facts to find the truth
toeic: An investigator was sent to examine the accounting records.
toeic_zh: 一名調查員被派去檢查會計紀錄。

en: Completely
toeic: The subsidiary is wholly owned by the parent company.
toeic_zh: 這家子公司由母公司全資擁有。

en: Used in per capita, meaning for each person
toeic: Per capita spending on travel has increased this year.
toeic_zh: 今年人均旅遊支出增加了。

en: The act of exchanging something for money or goods
toeic: The redemption of bonds will begin next month.
toeic_zh: 債券贖回將於下個月開始。

en: Never done or known before
simple_zh: 銷售達到前所未有的高點。
toeic: The company achieved unprecedented growth last year.
toeic_zh: 公司去年達成史無前例的成長。

en: The system of collecting taxes
toeic: Changes in taxation affect small business owners the most.
toeic_zh: 稅制的改變對小型企業主影響最大。

en: A person who owns money invested in business
toeic: The young capitalist invested in several tech start-ups.
toeic_zh: 這位年輕資本家投資了數家科技新創公司。

en: To control or limit something
toeic: The company introduced new rules to curb unnecessary costs.
toeic_zh: 公司訂定新規定以抑制不必要的成本。

en: To take a risk hoping for a good result
toeic: The firm decided to gamble on a new product line.
toeic_zh: 公司決定賭一把推出新產品線。

en: A single number from 0 to 9
toeic: Please enter the last four digits of your card number.
toeic_zh: 請輸入您信用卡號的最後四碼。

en: A person who has special knowledge within a group
simple: An insider gave us the news.
simple_zh: 一位內部人士給了我們消息。
toeic: Insider trading is illegal and punished by heavy fines.
toeic_zh: 內線交易是違法的，會被處以重罰。

en: careful and close examination
simple: The report is under close scrutiny.
simple_zh: 這份報告正受到嚴密審查。
toeic: The company's accounts came under scrutiny during the annual audit.
toeic_zh: 公司的帳目在年度查帳時受到嚴格審查。

en: staying the same; not changed
simple: The price stayed unchanged this year.
toeic: The interest rate remained unchanged at the central bank's latest meeting.
toeic_zh: 央行最新一次會議中利率維持不變。

en: having no legal force; void
simple: The old ticket is now null.
toeic: The contract becomes null and void if payment is not received.
toeic_zh: 若未收到款項，合約即失效。

en: to become smaller in size or amount
simple: My shirt will shrink in hot water.
simple_zh: 我的襯衫遇熱水會縮水。
toeic: Profits continued to shrink because of rising material costs.
toeic_zh: 由於原料成本上升，利潤持續縮減。

en: to hide the real nature of something
simple: He wore a hat to disguise himself.
toeic: The firm tried to disguise its losses in the quarterly report.
toeic_zh: 該公司試圖在季報中掩飾虧損。

en: making peace, or matching two sets of records
toeic: The accountant completed the bank reconciliation before the audit.
toeic_zh: 會計師在查核前完成了銀行對帳。

en: toward a lower level
toeic: Stock prices moved downward after the weak earnings report.
toeic_zh: 財報疲弱後，股價走低。

en: a lack of steadiness or security
toeic: Political instability has discouraged foreign investment in the region.
toeic_zh: 政治不穩定讓外國投資卻步。

en: a small solid piece, or a single payment
simple: There is a lump of sugar.
toeic: Employees may take their pension as a lump sum at retirement.
toeic_zh: 員工可在退休時一次領取退休金。

en: very small in size or importance
toeic: The new design brought only a marginal increase in sales.
toeic_zh: 新設計只帶來微幅的銷售成長。

en: toward a higher level
toeic: Housing prices continue to trend upward in the city center.
toeic_zh: 市中心的房價持續走升。

en: serious and without hope or cheer
toeic: The sales forecast looks grim for the next quarter.
toeic_zh: 下一季的銷售預測看來相當慘淡。

en: to control or handle something skillfully
simple: He can manipulate the machine well.
toeic: The report accused the firm of trying to manipulate stock prices.
toeic_zh: 報告指控該公司企圖操縱股價。

en: a group of companies working together
simple_zh: 一個聯合企業建造了這座橋。
toeic: A consortium of three banks will finance the construction project.
toeic_zh: 三家銀行組成的聯貸團將為這項建設計畫提供資金。

en: the act of leaving something or someone out
simple: His exclusion from the team was unfair.
simple_zh: 他被排除在隊外並不公平。
toeic: Check the exclusion list in your insurance policy carefully.
toeic_zh: 請仔細查看保單中的除外條款。

en: having doubts about something
simple: I am skeptical about this story.
simple_zh: 我對這個說法抱持懷疑。
toeic: Investors remain skeptical about the company's growth forecast.
toeic_zh: 投資人仍對公司的成長預測抱持懷疑。

en: a critical shortage or time of pressure
simple: We are in a time crunch.
toeic: The credit crunch made it hard for small firms to borrow money.
toeic_zh: 信貸緊縮使小型公司難以借錢。

en: the end or failure of something
simple: The shop's demise made us sad.
simple_zh: 這家店的結束讓我們難過。
toeic: Poor management led to the company's sudden demise.
toeic_zh: 管理不善導致公司突然倒閉。

en: a hopeful feeling about the future
toeic: There is growing optimism about the economy this year.
toeic_zh: 今年人們對經濟的樂觀情緒逐漸升高。

en: real and able to be touched or measured
toeic: The new system has produced tangible benefits for our customers.
toeic_zh: 新系統為我們的客戶帶來了具體的好處。

zh: 衍生性金融商品；衍生物
en: something developed from something else
simple: This word is a derivative of Latin.
toeic: The bank lost money trading financial derivative products.
toeic_zh: 這家銀行因交易衍生性金融商品而虧損。

en: relating to numbers
simple: Put the files in numerical order.
simple_zh: 把檔案依數字順序排好。
toeic: Please arrange the invoices in numerical order before filing them.
toeic_zh: 歸檔前請將發票依數字順序排列。

en: a large piece or part of something
simple: He ate a chunk of cheese.
toeic: A large chunk of our budget goes to advertising.
toeic_zh: 我們預算中很大一部分花在廣告上。

en: control that limits what you can do
simple: He showed restraint and stayed calm.
toeic: The company is urging restraint in spending this quarter.
toeic_zh: 公司呼籲本季節制開支。

en: the quality of being legal or acceptable
simple: They doubt the legitimacy of the offer.
simple_zh: 他們懷疑這個報價的合法性。
toeic: The court examined the legitimacy of the contract.
toeic_zh: 法院審查了該合約的合法性。

en: an official who controls an industry
simple_zh: 監管機構會檢查每家銀行。
toeic: The financial regulator approved the merger last week.
toeic_zh: 金融監管機構上週核准了這項合併。

en: the formal ending of a group or contract
simple: The dissolution of the band made fans sad.
simple_zh: 樂團解散讓粉絲很難過。
toeic: The partners agreed to the dissolution of the company.
toeic_zh: 合夥人同意解散公司。

en: done to trick people to get money
toeic: The bank detected a fraudulent transaction on her account.
toeic_zh: 銀行偵測到她帳戶上有一筆詐欺交易。

en: very small in amount; in name only
toeic: Members can use the gym for a nominal fee.
toeic_zh: 會員只需付少許費用即可使用健身房。

en: having a fair or equal relation in size
simple: Your pay is proportional to your work.
simple_zh: 你的薪水與工作量成比例。
toeic: Bonuses are proportional to each employee's sales results.
toeic_zh: 獎金與每位員工的銷售成績成正比。

en: rich and successful
toeic: The firm became prosperous after entering the Asian market.
toeic_zh: 這家公司進入亞洲市場後變得興旺。

en: one of several payments made over time
toeic: You can pay for the car in twelve installments.
toeic_zh: 您可以分十二期支付車款。

en: careful because you think there may be danger
toeic: Investors are wary of the unstable market.
toeic_zh: 投資人對不穩定的市場感到謹慎。

en: able to be changed into another form
simple: This sofa is convertible into a bed.
toeic: The bank issued convertible bonds to raise funds.
toeic_zh: 銀行發行可轉換債券來籌措資金。

en: a company that sells insurance
simple: Call your insurer after the crash.
simple_zh: 車禍後打電話給你的保險公司。
toeic: The insurer will pay for the repairs.
toeic_zh: 保險公司會支付維修費用。

en: to recover after a fall
simple: The ball will rebound off the wall.
toeic: Sales are expected to rebound in the next quarter.
toeic_zh: 預期銷售額將在下一季回升。

en: to hide something from others
simple: He tried to conceal the gift.
toeic: The firm was accused of concealing its financial losses.
toeic_zh: 該公司被控隱瞞財務虧損。

en: money given to support an organization
simple: The school received a large endowment.
toeic: The university's endowment funds new scholarships.
toeic_zh: 大學的基金資助新的獎學金。

en: to receive money or things from a dead person
toeic: The new manager will inherit several unfinished projects.
toeic_zh: 新經理將接手幾個未完成的專案。

en: remaining after the main part is gone
toeic: Residual value of the equipment is low after five years.
toeic_zh: 設備使用五年後殘值很低。
